title: Remobilization Fee on Resumption of Professional Services Projects Work
content:
For a fixed-fee Professional Services Projects engagement resumed after a client-caused hold longer than the class hold limit, and only for such a resumption, the remobilization fee is the restart remobilization fee. Every other resumption after a client-caused hold (at the client's request, for an unmet client dependency or for non-payment) longer than the class remobilization threshold in calendar days is invoiced the class remobilization fee.

| Resumption | Remobilization fee |
|---|---|
| fixed-fee engagement, client-caused hold longer than the class hold limit | the restart remobilization fee |
| any other resumption after a client-caused hold longer than the class remobilization threshold | the class remobilization fee |

## When the restart remobilization fee is invoiced

The remobilization fee of such a resumption is not invoiced until the engagement's billing carries the administration fee posted for the restart change order.

Said the other way round: as long as the engagement's billing shows no administration fee posted for the restart change order, the remobilization fee of such a resumption is not invoiced.

## Posting tool: `post_remobilization_fee_508d4151`

**Capability.** Posts the remobilization fee of an engagement whose work has resumed after a pause. A new remobilization charge is added to the engagement's billing with a newly assigned invoice number, today's date as its posting date and the current month as its billing month; the client can then see the remobilization fee and its amount on the engagement's billing.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_remobilization_fee_508d4151` (through `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `project_engagement_id` | the reference number of the project engagement that resumed, as returned by the project engagement lookup | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the remobilization fee in US dollars | a positive decimal number with 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation string giving the new billing entry reference, the invoice number (INV- followed by 6 digits), the engagement reference number, the fee in US dollars with two decimal places and the posting date in year-month-day form; that string indicates the remobilization fee was posted.
